Uttar Pradesh Students Protest Unpaved School Road

In Hamirpur, Uttar Pradesh, students, referred to as 'Gen Alpha', marched to the District Magistrate's office demanding a paved road to their school. Following coverage of the protest on Aaj Tak, district officials visited the village and began inspecting the road for construction. The students' protest aimed to highlight the lack of proper road access to their educational institution.
